pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Do not assume past product details without evidence
lesson.when: Checking past customer conversations or orders returns empty results and the product SKU is not established in context
lesson.do: Ask the customer directly to confirm or specify the exact product model instead of mentioning a specific SKU
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about past product details and ask for clarification without asserting unsupported SKUs
triggers: không có lịch sử đơn hàng
